en: Conditioned by a state that is not a root and is not to be abandoned by vision, a state that is a root and is to be abandoned by vision arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is not a root and is not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state that is a root and is to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

In dependence on a state that is not a root and is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, a state that is not a root and is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation [arises]... [and so forth].
A state not to be abandoned by either vision or cultivation arises conditioned by a root that is not a cause.

Dependent on a state that is not a root and is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, a state that is not a root and is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation arises conditioned by a root-condition.
(The first pair of roots is abbreviated; in all cases there are three.)
With respect to the root condition, three; with respect to the predominance condition, three …pe… with respect to the non-disappearance condition, three.
